title: Courses I plan to build
intro: No dates yet: these are topics from my own learning sessions, roughly in the order I'll turn them into puzzles.

upcoming.title: iOS for Android developers
upcoming.topics: Lifecycle, run loop, GCD, Swift concurrency, ARC.

upcoming.title: Encryption, from the ground up
upcoming.topics: Keys, key exchange, hashes, signatures, certificates and TLS.

upcoming.title: Bluetooth Low Energy, from the radio up
upcoming.topics: Radio and channel hopping, advertising and scanning, connections, GATT, pairing and bonding, Android's Bluetooth stack (and its famous status 133), throughput math.

upcoming.title: Mobile system design, from a packet to an app
upcoming.topics: TCP and TLS, HTTP and caching, round trips, offline-first with one source of truth, sync, safe rollouts and seeing problems in production.

upcoming.title: System design: the building blocks
upcoming.topics: Databases, caches, queues, consistency and CAP, idempotency, rate limiting, consensus, and why latency explodes near capacity.

upcoming.title: How LLMs and AI agents work
upcoming.topics: Tokens, transformers and attention, the KV cache, sampling, context windows and retrieval, embeddings, agents and tool use, checking AI output, on-device models.

upcoming.title: Kotlin Multiplatform and iOS for Android developers
upcoming.topics: The K2 compiler, source sets, Kotlin/Native memory, the Objective-C bridge, Swift concurrency, the run loop and app lifecycle on iOS.

upcoming.title: Data structures that earn their keep
upcoming.topics: Hash tables, heaps, graph search, B-trees and LSM trees, Bloom filters, CRDTs: what real systems use, and why.
